Welcome to St Polycarp’s Catholic Primary School
At St Polycarp’s, we offer every child a rich and inspiring environment where they can flourish academically, spiritually, and socially. Our dedicated staff are passionate about creating the very best primary school experience—one that nurtures each child's unique potential and encourages them to become confident, compassionate, and curious learners.
We are proud of our strong reputation for academic excellence and our commitment to fostering high aspirations, creativity, independence, and a lifelong love of learning. Our school is a vibrant, welcoming community where children feel safe, supported, and inspired every day.
As proud members of the Xavier Catholic Education Trust, our ethos is rooted in Gospel values, which shape every aspect of school life. We celebrate our Catholic identity while warmly welcoming families of all faiths and none.
Located just a short walk from Farnham town centre and train station, we serve a diverse and dynamic community from the local and surrounding areas. Catholic families, families of other faiths and no faith are all welcomed to our school.
Please contact the school to arrange a visit.

Governors
About the role of Governors
Governors work as a team called the local governing board.
The 3 core functions of the governing board are:
The governors of St Polycarp's Catholic Primary School believe it is important that committees reflect the diversity of the school communities they serve. Diverse committees promote inclusive school environments and provide diverse role models for staff and young people.
The governors are currently collecting data on the diversity of the LGC, including data on age, gender and ethnicity. They will use that data to inform their recruitment and training needs and ensure there is always a diverse range of perspectives around the table to support robust decision making.
Due to our relatively small governing body we do not publish this diversity data online as individual governors could be identified and we have a legal obligation to protect their personal data.
Current Governing Body
Headteacher - Ex Officio
Contact the Governors
If you wish to contact the governors, you can either write to the school for the attention of the chairman of the governors, Mr Martin Parr or email chair@stpolycarps.surrey.sch.uk .
Minutes of Governors Meetings
The minutes of all meetings held by the governing body are available to view at the school office by arrangement.
School Development Fund
Our ambition at St Polycarp's is to provide the very best education for all of our pupils.
The School Development Fund (previously known as the Governors Fund) is funded through parental donations and has always been a source of much needed capital for projects that have included: The classrooms for year R and Year 2 costing in excess of £1m, the kitchen enlargement 10 years ago costing around £250,000. More recently the entire cost of replacing many of the toilets, installing the IT suite and updating the outdoor play areas have been covered by contributions from the trust fund, and our amazing PTA.
If you don’t currently pay into the School Development Fund, we would be grateful if you could complete the online sign up via the ‘piggy bank’ icon on the top right hand side of the school website to add either a regular or one-off contribution. You can also contribute via CAF Donate here.
Please ask the school office if you require help with this.

Mrs Woolley (our SENDCo) has vast experience working with children and her role is very much about making sure our children flourish rather than just survive school. Asking for help… or being told our child may need help can feel uncomfortable but here at St Polycarp’s it is always about the child coming first.
If teachers, parents and support staff all work as a team we are far more likely to pick up and act on the challenges our children face in a physical sense and the problems not always evident on the surface, like learning difficulties or emotional distress. Wraparound Care - The Hive
Our quality wraparound childcare – The Hive – offers clubs from 7:30am to 6:00pm Monday to Friday, term time only (except Inset / School Closure days).
On a daily basis, we offer opportunities for the children to play indoor and outdoor games, do crafts, perform role-play, read with an adult, provide a quiet space for homework to be completed and more. We also organise themed activities around special times of the year, such as Christmas, Easter and Patron Saint days.
If you would like your child to attend our clubs, before booking, please ensure you have read the Wraparound Care Policy, Terms and Conditions, completed the Registration Form for each child attending and returned it to the school office.
NB: the Registration Form only needs to be completed once, that is before the first session your child ever attends at the Hive. If there are any changes to your details in the future (e.g. change of Emergency Contact Details), please complete a new form and return it to the school office, so that we can update our records.
Once we have received your completed Registration Form, you can book your child’s place by visiting www.scopay.com website and logging in with your email address and password. You can find a guide for booking here.
Payments can be made using a debit or credit card, childcare vouchers or tax free childcare account.
If making a payment using a debit or credit card please ensure you have a positive balance on your SCOPAY account.
If paying using tax free childcare account or childcare vouchers, please email Hive@stpolycarps.surrey.sch.uk so we can amend your SCOPAY account. You will then be able to book sessions and pay the balance by logging onto your childcare voucher or tax free childcare account.
